title: The Robot That Could Wait
title_ja: 待つことができるロボット
fact_notes: 人物・具体的な出来事・制度・実験結果は架空の教材例。実在する統計、法制度、医療指示、実証研究を示すものではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A team of students designed a model robot for an imaginary mission to inspect a distant planet.
sentences.ja: 生徒チームは遠い惑星を調査する架空の任務のため模型ロボットを設計した。

sentences.en: Their assignment required the robot to collect photographs while moving through a simulated rocky landscape.
sentences.ja: 課題では模擬の岩だらけの地形を移動し写真を集めることが求められた。

sentences.en: The students placed small obstacles on a classroom floor and wrote instructions for the robot to follow.
sentences.ja: 教室の床に小さな障害物を置きロボットの指示を書いた。

sentences.en: Initially, they concentrated on completing the planned route as quickly as possible.
sentences.ja: 当初は予定経路をできる限り速く完了することに集中した。

sentences.en: During the first test, the robot repeatedly approached an object that had been placed in an unexpected position.
sentences.ja: 最初の実験中ロボットは予想外の位置に置かれた物に繰り返し近づいた。

sentences.en: The instructions did not specify what to do when the usual path became blocked.
sentences.ja: 通常の道が塞がれたとき何をするか指示に定められていなかった。

sentences.en: A team member suggested increasing the robot's speed so that it could try more routes in the same period.
sentences.ja: 同じ時間内により多くの経路を試せるよう速度を上げる提案があった。

sentences.en: Another member argued that a faster response would not solve the problem of choosing an appropriate action.
sentences.ja: 別の生徒は反応が速くても適切な行動を選ぶ問題は解決しないと主張した。

sentences.en: The team decided to introduce a waiting state for situations that its existing instructions could not handle.
sentences.ja: 既存の指示で扱えない状況のため待機状態を導入することにした。

sentences.en: When the robot encountered an unknown obstacle, it would stop and record the surrounding conditions.
sentences.ja: 未知の障害物に遭遇すると停止し周辺の状況を記録する。

sentences.en: It would then request guidance rather than continue moving according to an unsuitable instruction.
sentences.ja: 不適切な指示に従い動き続ける代わりに案内を求める。

sentences.en: The students also designed a time limit for each attempt so the robot could not repeat a failed action indefinitely.
sentences.ja: 失敗した行動を無期限に繰り返さないよう試行の時間制限も設けた。

sentences.en: During the second test, the revised robot took longer to complete the ordinary parts of the route.
sentences.ja: 第二の実験では改良ロボットは通常部分を完了するのに時間がかかった。

sentences.en: However, its behavior became easier for the students to examine when an unexpected obstacle appeared.
sentences.ja: しかし予期しない障害物が現れた際の動作を調べやすくなった。

sentences.en: The team documented both improvements and disadvantages rather than reporting only its most successful demonstration.
sentences.ja: 最も成功した実演だけを報告せず改善点と欠点の両方を記録した。

sentences.en: They acknowledged that their simple classroom model could not establish the reliability of a real planetary robot.
sentences.ja: 簡単な教室模型では実際の惑星探査ロボットの信頼性は確立できないと認めた。

sentences.en: The experience encouraged the students to reconsider how the performance of an intelligent system should be evaluated.
sentences.ja: この経験から知的システムの性能をどう評価すべきか再考した。

sentences.en: A system that pauses when its information is insufficient may be more useful than one that always produces an immediate action.
sentences.ja: 情報が不十分なとき停止するシステムは常に即座に行動するものより役立つことがある。

sentences.en: In their model, waiting was not simply a failure to complete a task.
sentences.ja: 模型では待機は単に作業の未完了ではなかった。

sentences.en: It was a deliberate response to a situation that required further information before a responsible decision could be made.
sentences.ja: 責任ある判断の前にさらなる情報が必要な状況への意図的な反応だった。

far away in space or distance
a large body orbiting a star
the appearance or features of an area
information telling someone what to do
bringing a task to an end
a way from one point to another
an action in answer to something
help in deciding what to do
for an unlimited or unknown time
an act showing how something works

options: Design a model robot for a planetary inspection mission.
questions.explanation_ja: 惑星調査の模型ロボット。

questions.prompt: What did the students first focus on?
options: Making the robot wait for every instruction.
questions.explanation_ja: 経路を速く完了すること。

questions.prompt: What happened during the first test?
options: It stopped working completely before moving.
It photographed nothing because there was no route.
The robot repeatedly approached an unexpected object.
questions.explanation_ja: 想定外の物体に繰り返し接近。

options: The robot already moved faster than light.
The robot still lacked a suitable action for the situation.
The students wanted to remove every instruction.
questions.explanation_ja: 適切な行動選択の問題が残った。

questions.prompt: What would the robot do when encountering an unknown obstacle?
Why did the team set a time limit?
options: To prevent endless repetition of a failed action.
To make the robot ignore every obstacle.
To finish all tests without recording results.
To ensure every route was identical.
questions.explanation_ja: 失敗の無限反復を防ぐ。

questions.prompt: What disadvantage appeared in the second test?
options: The robot no longer stopped at unexpected obstacles.
The model proved every real space condition.
Ordinary sections of the route took longer.
questions.explanation_ja: 通常の経路に時間がかかった。

questions.prompt: Why mention the limitations of the classroom model?
options: The students had already tested it on another planet.
The assignment required actual space travel.
The team had proved the design perfect.
It could not prove the reliability of a real planetary robot.
questions.explanation_ja: 実際の探査での信頼性は確立できない。

options: A fast action is always better than waiting.
A system can benefit from pausing when it lacks enough information.
Every unknown obstacle must be ignored.
Classroom tests guarantee real mission success.
questions.explanation_ja: 情報不足時に待つことにも価値がある。

grammar.focus: while moving through a simulated rocky landscape
grammar.explanation_ja: while＋現在分詞は同時進行を示す。

grammar.focus: would not solve the problem of choosing
grammar.explanation_ja: would notは予想される結果の否定。
rather thanは選ばない行動との対比。

grammar.focus: that pauses when its information is insufficient
grammar.explanation_ja: 関係代名詞that以下がsystemを修飾。

paraphrases.source: Their assignment required the robot to collect photographs while moving through a simulated rocky landscape.
paraphrases.rewrite: The task was to gather images as the robot traveled through a model rocky environment.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 模擬地形を移動し撮影する。

paraphrases.source: Another member argued that a faster response would not solve the problem of choosing an appropriate action.
paraphrases.rewrite: Another student argued that faster movement would still leave the question of what to do unanswered.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 速さだけでは行動選択の問題を解決しない。

paraphrases.source: It would then request guidance rather than continue moving according to an unsuitable instruction.
paraphrases.rewrite: It would ask for further direction instead of proceeding with an inappropriate command.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 不適切な指示で進まず案内を求める。

paraphrases.source: A system that pauses when its information is insufficient may be more useful than one that always produces an immediate action.
paraphrases.rewrite: A system that stops when it lacks enough information can be more helpful than one that reacts at once in every case.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 情報不足時の停止にも価値がある。

discourse.role_ja: 継続動作と案内を求める行動を対比。
動作時間の欠点と調査しやすさの利点を対比。
待機の意味を単純な失敗に限定しない。

cloze.explanation_ja: 通常の経路が塞がれた。
実際の機器の信頼性は確立できない。
